sn1.9:1.1: Ekam antaṃ ṭhitā kho sā devatā Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
sn1.9:2.1: Na mānakāmassa damo idh-atthi || na monam atthi asamāhitassa || eko araññe viharaṃ pamatto || na maccudheyyassa tareyya pāran ti || ||
sn1.9:3.1: Mānam pahāya susamāhitatto || sucetaso sabbadhi vippamutto || eko araññe viharaṃ appamatto || sa maccudheyyassa tareyya pāran ti || ||
